records.claim: The use of valproic acid during pregnancy can cause temporary symptoms, such as jitteriness and irritability, in newborns soon after birth. These symptoms are sometimes referred to as withdrawal. Not all babies exposed to valproic acid will have these symptoms. There have been reports of temporary low blood sugar levels (hypoglycemia) in newborns. It is important that your healthcare providers know you are taking valproic acid so that if symptoms occur your baby can get the care that is best for them.
records.source_section: I need to take valproic acid during my pregnancy. Will it cause withdrawal symptoms in my baby after birth?
